## Definition of Done

- [ ] Tests written before the implementation, and failing at that point
- [ ] Every acceptance criterion in the feature file has a test
- [ ] Documentation updated in substance, not cosmetically
- [ ] Trace anchors in the code and in the tests
- [ ] No `TODO` / `FIXME` / `HACK` without a `DEBT-XXX`
- [ ] Nothing new moved into `shared/` without agreement
- [ ] Security list walked, if this touches uploads, forms or the admin area
